# Ownership

| Authority | Accountable owner |
|---|---|
| Product outcomes | Neel |
| Architecture and invariants | Neel |
| Security and credentials | Neel |
| Release and production promotion | Neel |
| Code and implementation boundaries | Neel |
| Final accountable human escalation | Neel |

Agents may propose governed changes. Human owners approve constitutional changes, exceptions,
and production consequences. Tool availability does not grant authority.
